name: AFTERSHOCK: A Humanitarian Crisis Game
description: A role-based simulation game that models coordination challenges in post-disaster humanitarian response. It evaluates decision-making, negotiation, and inter-organizational collaboration under resource constraints and uncertainty. Often used for training and research in crisis management.
reputation: Widely used in humanitarian training and academic simulations, but not a standard AI benchmark.
notes: Not a standardized benchmark dataset; evaluation is subjective and scenario-dependent.
